# Locally bundled ELK.js

Pinned package: **elkjs 0.12.0**, upstream <https://github.com/kieler/elkjs>.
Original package archive: <https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz>.
License declaration: **EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later**. This project uses the EPL-2.0 option; the unmodified upstream `LICENSE.md` and `README.md` accompany the unmodified `elk.bundled.js`.

The original downloaded archive is retained in `evidence/phase3-preflight-2026-10-26/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz`. Upstream JavaScript and source/build information are available from the repository and original package. The local `package.json` is a project sidecar for Node's CommonJS loader and version/license identification; it does not modify the bundle. No npm install or package lifecycle scripts were used. The app dynamically loads this same-origin bundle; there is no CDN or external layout service. Fingerprints are recorded in `integrity.json`.
